<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that converts an aldehyde and a phosphonium ylide into an alkene (Wittig reaction). Using the available functional group names, we search for templates that break “aldehydes” and form “C‑C double bonds”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
